## Invitations

The outreach recorded 1472 invitations during the reporting period. Of those invited, 140 people attended. This gives an attendance rate of 9.5. The figures provide a summary of participation from the invitation stage through to attendance. They should be considered together when reviewing the reach of the outreach activity and the level of engagement achieved.

The attendance figure represents the people who took part after receiving an invitation. The rate is reported as 9.5, alongside the underlying counts of 140 attendees and 1472 invitees. Keeping both the totals and the rate in the report supports clear review of the activity.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1251 invitees. The recorded reminder figure was 0. These figures distinguish the number reached by SMS from the number recorded for reminders and provide the available contact information for the period.
